digest.component_or_area: metrics and code-health derivations from git
propositions: read-only derivations over git history and working tree must compute module-size distribution, cap-change events, short-term churn, and refactor-to-addition ratio against a single flat hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt
module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts at a ref against the single-sourced cap and returns count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc
cap_change_events returns a list of {commit, old_limit, new_limit} dicts from git log history of .github/module-size-limit.txt; an empty list when no changes occur in the range
churn sums insertions and deletions from git log --numstat over a range; refactor_to_addition_ratio returns deletions/insertions or None when total insertions is zero

four MetricSpec entries (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) must be registered in REGISTRY with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high, and context-adapter computes that call the raw functions
